name: Report Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies whether the report contains a new, a resubmitted or an amended baseline.

FWIS.name: Forward Initial Submission
FWIS.definition: The report contains a baseline submitted for the first time.

FWRE.name: Forward Re Submission
FWRE.definition: The report contains a baseline that is resubmitted.

FWAM.name: Forward Amend
FWAM.definition: The report contains a baseline that is amended.
